# ORVESEN Typography System

Version: 1.0

---

# Philosophy

Typography is communication.

Users should instantly understand the importance of every piece of information.

Typography creates hierarchy before color.

Consistency is more important than variety.

# Text Colors

---

# Alignment

Default

Left

Avoid centered text unless necessary.

Enterprise software values readability over decoration.

---

# Rules

Never use more than four text sizes on the same screen.

Never use bold everywhere.

Hierarchy should come from spacing first.

Typography should remain calm and predictable.

The user should immediately know what deserves attention.

---

# Experience Goal

Reading should feel effortless.

Users should never struggle to identify what is important.

The interface should feel structured, intelligent and premium.
